title: REHASH: reload the daemon's configuration, and say what could not be
close_reason: REHASH reads the configuration file again, applies invites, and names every other changed setting as needing a restart; RESTART is 481. The two lists and the rule that generates them are in docs/design/agent-frontends.md §7.38, with the 382 deviation in decision mimid-1wgh.145. The TLS certificate and the did:webvh log file are deliberately not re-read (bead mimid-1wgh.140.9, labelled human), and SIGHUP is bead mimid-1wgh.140.10. Commit 7b846d53 on branch irc-verbs.
